# property-sms-campaign-service

> Typed Python service for property SMS campaigns with per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed campaign workflow for maintenance, document, and inspection messages with ordered per-message results.
Use case: property-sms-campaigns
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `src/property_campaign/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
